component.name: LinuxShot
component.summary: Native Linux screenshot and image-annotation application

description.p: LinuxShot is a native Linux screenshot and image-annotation tool delivering a fast, intuitive region-capture and on-screen editing experience inspired by Lightshot.

ul.li: Fast region capture, full desktop capture, and multi-monitor support
8 vector annotation tools: pen, line, arrow, rectangle, circle, marker, text, and blur/pixelate
X11 zero-copy capture via XCB-SHM and Wayland support via XDG Desktop Portal
Save to PNG, JPEG, and BMP formats or copy directly to clipboard
Custom self-hosted image upload endpoint and optional prnt.sc provider support
